text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌۭ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a linked moral rule rather than a detached proverb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens as a resumptive connector, carrying the best-speaker profile of 41:33 into a rule for conduct under conflict. The ayah begins with relation before negation, so the denied comparison is not an isolated proverb but linked guidance. Its short cadence before the negator makes that handoff audible.

topics.headline: linked rule opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah continues the prior speaker profile while launching a rule for conflict conduct.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction scopes over the whole negated comparison clause and the boundary rows tie it to 41:33.

topics.headline: connector heard before negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the moral rule begin with relation before refusal, so the transition into negation is marked audibly.
topics.reason: The segmented particle is visible before the negator, and the sound row supports that transition.

words.gloss_range: first negator scoping over the equality predicate and blocking moral leveling
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) stands before the equality verb and blocks the act of moral leveling itself. Because the negator will be repeated before the second pole, the listener hears non-equivalence as a frame rather than a passing denial. The first refusal prepares the command to preserve difference instead of answering harm by imitation.

topics.headline: negation blocks leveling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is denied is the equality relation itself, not merely one moral pole.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the negator directly over the imperfect equality verb.

topics.headline: first half of doubled refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears non-equivalence beginning as a doubled frame that will be renewed before the second noun.
topics.reason: The first negator stands separately before the verb and is echoed by the second negator.

words.gloss_range: negated imperfect equality relation; ongoing refusal that good and evil can become level
words.root_gloss_range: levelness, equality, proportion, and making even; the local imperfect negates moral leveling rather than activating every root branch
words.prose: {{ar:تَسْتَوِى}} ({{tr:tastawī}}) is the standing equality relation the ayah refuses. Its imperfect and intransitive shape makes non-leveling an ongoing moral axiom, not a completed comparison or an active act of making one side equal to the other. The root’s levelness field becomes ethical pressure: the listener must not flatten good and evil onto one plane, a comparison pattern also used to deny false equivalence in 5:100. The command that follows is structurally downstream from that premise, and the verb’s sound and root sit between the opposed moral poles rather than floating as neutral measurement.

topics.headline: imperfect intransitive denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices moral non-equivalence as a standing relation, not a one-time comparison or an active equalizing act.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect, feminine, and intransitive in the local comparison clause.

topics.headline: levelness becomes ethical pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels equality language as a refusal of ethical flattening, while local grammar keeps the sense to the denied comparison.
topics.reason: The root field supports levelness and parity pressure, but the local negated imperfect selects non-equivalence rather than every root branch.

topics.headline: known unequal-pair construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the equality construction as part of a Quranic comparison pattern that denies false equivalence, including 5:100.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete comparison parallels and no local evidence contradicts them.

topics.headline: axiom precedes action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is downstream from the moral axiom, so action must enact non-equivalence.
topics.reason: The clause order places the negated comparison before the imperative.

topics.headline: sound and root sit between poles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the equality verb caught between opposed moral poles rather than floating as neutral measurement.
topics.reason: The local sequence frames the verb with the two moral nouns, and the sound rows reinforce that placement.

words.gloss_range: definite good category as the first comparison pole, carrying moral beauty and fittingness
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, fittingness, benefit, and excellence; locally the root supplies both the good category and the superior response standard
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَسَنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥasanatu}}) names the known good category first inside the denied comparison. It carries moral beauty, fittingness, and benefit as the positive pole before any command is given, with clean articulation before the more sibilant bad pole. That category later returns as a superior response standard, so goodness is not only identified; it becomes the quality by which harm is to be answered, sharpening the warding-evil-by-good logic also named in 28:54.

topics.headline: definite first moral pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices good as a recognized category placed first under the denied equality frame.
topics.reason: The noun is definite feminine nominative and functions as the first compared subject/category.

topics.headline: good carries beauty and fittingness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the good pole is morally beautiful and fitting, while the local noun remains the compared category.
topics.reason: The root range supports beauty, benefit, and excellence; local grammar selects the definite comparison noun.

topics.headline: category becomes response standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices goodness moving from category to operative better response, with 28:54 as a recurrence of warding evil by good.
topics.reason: The rows connect the noun to the later elative and to concrete recurrence without overriding the local parse.

topics.headline: good named before badness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the good pole arrive first, so evil enters as contrast rather than norm.
topics.reason: The word order and recitational rows support the first-pole effect.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that joins the second moral pole into the same comparison without collapsing the contrast
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second moral pole into the same comparison while keeping the joining controlled. The two categories are brought together only so their equality can be denied. Its visible position before the renewed negator shows that coordination and refusal are both active.

topics.headline: joined for comparison, not sameness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two moral poles are joined only to have their equality denied.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two nouns under the same negated predicate, while the repeated negator prevents collapse.

topics.headline: connector and negator both work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees coordination and renewed negation as separate operations in the comparison.
topics.reason: Bundle segmentation exposes the conjunction before the second negator, and the ayah later reuses conjunction at relation pivots.

words.gloss_range: renewed negator before the bad pole, distributing non-equivalence across both sides
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews the negative boundary before the bad pole. The repetition prevents the second noun from trailing after the first as an equal option under one shared metric. The command that follows is therefore heard after a doubled refusal of moral collapse.

topics.headline: second negation protects the bad pole boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bad pole enters with its own negative boundary, not as an equal alternative.
topics.reason: The second negator is repeated before the second compared noun, distributing non-equivalence.

topics.headline: doubled refusal is heard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the comparison resist smooth assimilation before the command begins.
topics.reason: The separate particle interrupts noun coordination and echoes the first negator.

words.gloss_range: definite harmful category as the second comparison pole; ugliness and injury named before the command answers them
words.root_gloss_range: evil, ugliness, harm, shame, and distress; locally it names the harmful moral category answered without imitation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sayyiʾatu}}) completes the comparison as a definite harmful category, not yet as the object of the command. Its field includes ugliness, injury, shame, and evil, so the later response faces real harm without borrowing its harmful mode. The good-warding-evil pattern known from 13:22 is sharpened here into direct strategy. Standing immediately before the imperative, it makes the command answer evil directly while the opening frame forbids mimicry.

topics.headline: definite second moral pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices evil as a recognizable category inside the comparison before it becomes something to answer.
topics.reason: The noun mirrors the first pole in definiteness, femininity, and nominative case within the comparison.

topics.headline: harmful ugliness without imitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the offense as real harm and ugliness, while the local noun remains a moral category rather than every root branch.
topics.reason: The root field supports harm, ugliness, shame, and evil; local grammar selects the definite abstract bad category.

topics.headline: warding formula background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the later command as part of a pattern where evil is warded by good, including 13:22, but sharpened here into direct strategy.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows name concrete parallels and fit the local command sequence.

topics.headline: command answers evil directly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command arriving immediately after the bad pole, so the response must answer evil without mirroring it.
topics.reason: The local order places the noun just before the imperative, after the non-equivalence frame.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperative of controlled repulsion; object left broad while the permitted means is narrowed by the following phrase
words.root_gloss_range: pushing away, warding off, defending, and at times handing over; locally the imperative selects controlled repulsion through a superior means
words.prose: {{ar:ٱدْفَعْ}} ({{tr:idfaʿ}}) turns the moral axiom into a direct second-person command. The object is left unstated, so what must be repelled can include evil, harm, enmity, or the impulse to retaliate; the following instrument phrase narrows only the permitted means. The root gives active counter-force, but the local construction disciplines that force through the better response and links the command to the marked better-repulsion formula also seen in 23:96. The clipped command sound launches force, then the following relative phrase softens and channels it.

topics.headline: listener must enact the principle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is moved from recognizing moral difference to being directly commanded to practice it.
topics.reason: The verb is a second masculine singular imperative with its subject carried in the form.

topics.headline: unstated object widens what is repelled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target is broad enough for evil, harm, enmity, or retaliatory impulse, while the means is specified.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence notes the imperative with object elided and an instrumental phrase following.

topics.headline: force constrained by better means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels active counter-force, while the following instrument keeps it from becoming retaliatory imitation.
topics.reason: The root range supports pushing away and warding off, but local grammar subordinates the action to the better instrument.

topics.headline: marked better-repulsion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the command as a marked formula shared with 23:96 and specialized here for interpersonal enmity.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete formulaic parallel and low-occurrence profile.

topics.headline: hinge from axiom to result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the imperative as the ayah’s hinge: force launches, then is softened by the better instrument.
topics.reason: The command sits between the comparison and result clause, and the sound rows reinforce controlled repulsion.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition making the better response the means by which repulsion happens
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the better response the instrument of repulsion. The grammar foregrounds method over target: what matters first is not naming what is pushed away, but how the pushing-away is done. Because the preposition is bound directly to the relative phrase, the command and its ethical means are visibly compressed, and its b-sound anticipates the later relation-space.

topics.headline: means rather than object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the better response is the instrument of repulsion, so method outranks target.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following relative as governed by the preposition and attached to the imperative.

topics.headline: method fused to relative phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the response-mode inseparable from the command, with sound anticipating the later relation-space.
topics.reason: The proclitic is bound to the relative pronoun, and the phonetic row links the instrument to the later between-language.

words.gloss_range: feminine relative pronoun with an unstated antecedent, keeping the response type open but governed by the better standard
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) leaves the response-type unnamed while keeping it grammatically controlled. The means may be a deed, quality, way, or response, but it must be defined by the predicate that follows. Its feminine relative form also prepares a contrast with the later masculine relative: one introduces the better method, the other introduces the hostile counterpart.

topics.headline: unnamed better response type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no single tactic is named; the response remains open as long as it is defined by superior goodness.
topics.reason: The feminine relative is governed by the instrumental preposition and has an implied feminine antecedent.

topics.headline: method relative mirrors person relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees method and counterpart held by paired relative forms, making the transformation grammatically balanced.
topics.reason: The first relative introduces the instrument phrase, and the later masculine relative introduces the person in the result.

words.gloss_range: explicit feminine pronoun forming a nominal predication that defines the response-standard
words.prose: {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) makes the relative phrase into a small nominal predication. The better means is paused over and defined, not allowed to blur into a loose modifier. Its feminine agreement keeps the response-standard separate from the person who will appear in the result scene.

topics.headline: explicit pronoun defines the instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the better mode is predicated and defined, not left as a loose adjective.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following elative as predicated of the pronoun.

topics.headline: feminine resumption keeps referents clear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the better means kept distinct from the hostile person before the result scene begins.
topics.reason: The feminine pronoun resumes the feminine relative and slows the phrase before the elative.

words.gloss_range: elative good/better/best predicate inside the instrument phrase, making superior fittingness the mode of response
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, fittingness, benefit, and excellence; locally the root supplies both the good category and the superior response standard
words.prose: {{ar:أَحْسَنُ}} ({{tr:aḥsanu}}) is the elative standard inside the instrument phrase. The response must be better or best in moral beauty, fittingness, and benefit, not merely less harmful than the offense. It carries the best-speech thread from 41:33 into conflict conduct and participates in the better-repulsion formula also known from 23:96. Because it closes the command phrase just before the result marker, superior goodness becomes the hinge that moves the ayah from instruction into warm social reversal.

topics.headline: better quality governs repulsion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that superior quality defines the means of repulsion, with comparison left open rather than tied to one explicit standard.
topics.reason: The elative is the predicate inside the instrumental relative clause and lacks an explicit comparison complement.

topics.headline: beauty and fittingness become method
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees goodness upgraded into active strategy, while the local elative remains the selected response standard.
topics.reason: The root range supports beauty, benefit, and excellence, and the elative form intensifies it within the command.

topics.headline: bestness thread becomes conflict practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects best speech in 41:33 to better conflict conduct in 41:34 and the formula also known from 23:96.
topics.reason: The rows supply same-surah and formulaic recurrence without changing the local predicate role.

topics.headline: superiority lands before result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command phrase ending on superior goodness just before the sudden relational reversal.
topics.reason: The word is the last item of the command phrase before the consequence particle.

words.gloss_range: consequence connector binding the command to the sudden result scene
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) binds the result scene to the command. The ally-like outcome is not detached consolation; it is grammatically connected to repelling by the better means. In the fused result opening, the ayah moves without delay from method into what becomes visible.

topics.headline: command bound to result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ally-like scene is grammatically tied to the better response, not detached consolation.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the result clause after the imperative clause.

topics.headline: method turns into displayed scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move quickly from axiom to method to visible relational consequence.
topics.reason: The prefixed form joins the consequence particle to the sudden-result marker and begins the final clause.

words.gloss_range: sudden-result particle after the consequence connector, presenting the transformation as a startling scene
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) after the consequence marker opens a sudden-result scene. It is not ordinary timing but a behold-like presentation: the listener is made to see the relation change after the better response. The glottal onset adds a small audible arrest at the point of surprise.

topics.headline: behold-like transformation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the result as a sudden displayed scene rather than a routine time condition.
topics.reason: The fa-idhā environment selects sudden-result force and scopes over the final nominal predication.

topics.headline: sound marks the surprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a small arrest before the result scene opens.
topics.reason: The selected particle, not a past circumstance particle, follows the consequence marker; the hamza row supports the sudden turn.

words.gloss_range: masculine relative subject identifying the counterpart by relation before he is re-predicated
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) introduces the counterpart through description rather than by an enemy label. The person is carried through the between-space and then into the later pronoun, so the same referent can be re-predicated. Its relative form mirrors the earlier method-relative, pairing the better response with the person whose relation may change, and hostility is delayed until relation-space has first been staged.

topics.headline: relative identifies without enemy label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the counterpart described through a relation before being recast, rather than named as an enemy by essence.
topics.reason: The masculine relative heads the phrase that identifies the person through the following between-space and hostility.

topics.headline: person relative mirrors method relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the better means and hostile person balanced by relative forms, with hostility delayed until relation-space is named.
topics.reason: The earlier feminine relative names the method, and this masculine relative introduces the counterpart in the result.

words.gloss_range: first adverbial between-phrase with second-person suffix, locating hostility in the interval involving the addressee
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, interval, connection, and clarity; locally the adverbial construct marks the interpersonal space where hostility is located
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَكَ}} ({{tr:baynaka}}) begins the relation-space and puts the addressee inside it. Hostility is located in an interval involving you, not in abstract conflict elsewhere. The root’s between-ness, separation, and clarity make the gap visible enough to be addressed; the repeated interval becomes the structural center before hostility is named. Later nearness will reverse that geometry, with 60:7 offering a concrete parallel for affection placed between former enemies.

topics.headline: your side of the interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command concerns a relation involving the addressee, not abstract hostility elsewhere.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix is bound to the first adverbial between-word in the relative phrase.

topics.headline: hostility located in an interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hostility placed in a two-coordinate space rather than inside one person as essence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the between-phrase adverbial to the hostility noun and coordinated with the second between-phrase.

topics.headline: between-space is visible and transformable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the interval as both separation and a clear relation that can be addressed, while local grammar keeps the adverbial sense.
topics.reason: The root range supports between-ness and clarity; the local construct selects relational location.

topics.headline: distance prepared for reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gap prepared for reversal into nearness, with 60:7 as a concrete affection-between parallel.
topics.reason: The rows tie between-language to hostility and ally-nearness, including same-surah and cross-passage recurrence.

topics.headline: first between starts the heavy frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reciprocal interval become the structural center of the result scene.
topics.reason: The repeated between construction and sound rows make the relation-space prominent before hostility is named.

words.gloss_range: connector completing the reciprocal between-phrase rather than adding a new independent element
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) completes the reciprocal construction by joining the second side of the interval. It does not add a new scene; it makes the relation two-coordinate. The same connector that joined moral poles now joins personal endpoints without erasing their difference.

topics.headline: second side joined into one interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hostility as a shared relation-space rather than a one-sided state.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two between-phrases inside one relative clause.

topics.headline: joining without erasing difference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same joining logic used for moral poles and personal coordinates: relation is made visible without collapsing difference.
topics.reason: The connector recurs at comparison and reciprocal-relation pivots.

words.gloss_range: second adverbial between-phrase with third-person suffix, completing the counterpart side of the interval
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, interval, connection, and clarity; locally the adverbial construct marks the interpersonal space where hostility is located
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَهُۥ}} ({{tr:baynahū}}) supplies the counterpart’s side of the interval. The suffix keeps the hostile person present before the as-if predicate recasts him, and the repeated between-word makes the gap itself prominent. Once the two-sided frame is complete, hostility can land as what occupies the relation rather than as either person’s essence. The completed distance closes just before ally-nearness opens, with 5:14 as a concrete enmity-between parallel.

topics.headline: his side of the interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the counterpart held grammatically in the same relation before he is recast by the as-if predicate.
topics.reason: The second between-word supplies the counterpart coordinate and its suffix resumes the relative subject.

topics.headline: relation-space before evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the interval completed before hostility is named, so evaluation lands inside relation-space.
topics.reason: The repeated adverbial construction locks the two suffixes into one reciprocal frame.

topics.headline: distance closes before ally-nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears distance language close just before the final ally-nearness language opens, with 5:14 as an enmity-between parallel.
topics.reason: The rows connect the completed between-space with hostility and later nearness, including concrete recurrence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite abstract hostility located in the between-space, severe but not frozen as the person's essence
words.root_gloss_range: enmity, hostility, transgression, exceeding bounds, and attack; locally the abstract noun names hostility as a relation-condition
words.prose: {{ar:عَدَٰوَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿadāwatun}}) names serious hostility, but as an indefinite abstract condition in the between-space. The root field gives boundary-crossing enmity real force, while the form avoids freezing the person as an enemy by identity. It belongs to an enmity-between pattern also seen in 5:91, now answered by the better response. Its placement immediately before the as-if phrase makes the final ally-like predicate arrive against the sharpest possible contrast.

topics.headline: enmity named as condition, not identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hostility as a relation-condition between persons, not as an enemy label that freezes the counterpart.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite abstract predicate within the relative phrase, located after the between-space.

topics.headline: real hostility but transformable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the hostility as serious boundary-crossing, while the abstract local form keeps it open to transformation.
topics.reason: The root field supports hostility and transgression; local grammar selects the abstract relation noun.

topics.headline: enmity placed between people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes an enmity-between pattern, including 5:91, now answered by better response.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete recurrence and co-occurrence with between and ally fields.

topics.headline: sharp contrast before likeness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the strongest hostile term standing immediately before the as-if ally predicate.
topics.reason: The word order places hostility at the edge of the final re-predication.

words.gloss_range: as-if particle with attached pronoun, carrying the same person into a cautious ally predicate
words.prose: {{ar:كَأَنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:ka-annahū}}) carries the same hostile person into a cautious likeness. The particle opens hope for relational transformation without saying that appearance is simple identity. Its attached pronoun preserves continuity across the reversal: the one on the hostile side of the interval is the one now likened to an intimate ally.

topics.headline: likeness without identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hope of transformation stated as likeness, without claiming naive total identity.
topics.reason: The particle governs the final predicate and licenses resemblance rather than unqualified identity.

topics.headline: suffix carries the hostile referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the same person from the hostile relation is carried into the ally-like predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as the particle complement and the following noun as predicate.

topics.headline: grammar cushions the extreme turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the move from hostility to alliance as imaginable because the as-if grammar preserves the distance crossed.
topics.reason: The particle follows the hostility noun and introduces the final predicate under simile restraint.

words.gloss_range: indefinite concrete ally predicate, recasting the hostile referent as near/protective within the as-if frame
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, following, loyalty, protection, alliance, and friendship; locally the concrete predicate names ally-like nearness within the simile frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَلِىٌّ}} ({{tr:waliyyun}}) is the ally-like predicate assigned to that same person inside the as-if frame. Its concrete and indefinite form presents a relational type rather than a fixed office, while the root’s nearness and protective-alliance field reverses the earlier distance. Protective-nearness language such as 2:257 is applied here horizontally to a transformed adversary. The following adjective prevents the outcome from stopping at cold alliance.

topics.headline: new relation predicated of the adversary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relation changes without introducing a new actor; the hostile person is re-predicated as ally-like.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this noun the predicate of the as-if particle for the same referent.

topics.headline: ally type, not fixed office
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees allyship as an open relational type inside the simile, not a named permanent office.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite nominative as the predicate governed by the simile particle.

topics.headline: distance reverses into protective nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels between-distance reversed into nearness and support, while local grammar keeps the concrete ally predicate.
topics.reason: The root range supports nearness, following, protection, and alliance; local syntax selects the noun predicate.

topics.headline: protective-nearness applied horizontally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes protective-nearness language, including 2:257, applied horizontally to a transformed adversary.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete recurrence and co-occurrence with between and hostility fields.

topics.headline: ally role intensified by warmth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reversal does not stop at formal alliance; the following adjective warms the new relation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final adjective as qualifying this noun in the same predicate phrase.

words.gloss_range: intensive adjective qualifying the ally predicate with warm intimacy and closing the ayah on that quality
words.root_gloss_range: heat, intensity, closeness, and intimate friendship; locally the adjective selects warm intimacy while retaining heat/intensity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:حَمِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ḥamīmun}}) qualifies the ally image and closes the ayah on warm intimacy. The local sense selects intimate closeness, while the heat and intensity field makes the relation feel warmed rather than merely non-hostile. Its placement after ally and repeated between-language makes the warm ending distributionally marked. As the last word, with lingering cadence, it leaves the listener with the felt endpoint of better repulsion: hostility’s heat redirected into closeness.

topics.headline: warmth qualifies the ally image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices warmth as part of the same as-if ally predicate, not a separate role.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as an adjective qualifying the preceding ally noun under the simile frame.

topics.headline: heat becomes social warmth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels intimate warmth rather than mere non-hostility, while local usage selects the friend/intimacy side of the heat field.
topics.reason: The root field includes heat and closeness; the local adjective qualifies the ally predicate as warm intimacy.

topics.headline: rare warm closure after distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the close warm ending as distributionally marked after the ally and between fields.

topics.headline: ayah lands on warm intimacy

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated equivalence of the good and the evil is followed by the imperative to push with what is better.
baseline_models.mechanism: Non-equivalence blocks mirrored retaliation: دفع supplies active displacement of harm, while the repeated حسن escalates from a good act to the better one, making excess good a counterforce rather than a passive courtesy.

activation_trace.role: Equality and equivalence provide the scale that the negation refuses to apply to good and evil.
Doing good, benefitting another, and exceeding bare justice turn the comparative أحسن into the operative countermeasure.
What causes distress or injury names the incoming force that is not to be reproduced.
Removing a thing from its place and warding off harm make the better act an active displacement.

changed_reading.before: Answer an evil act with generic kindness.
changed_reading.after: Refuse evil's demand for an equivalent reply and use a deliberately superior good as the force that displaces it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated بين marks the interval between two persons, and the result replaces عداوة with ولي حميم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object of transformation is the relation occupying the between-space: hostile separation gives way to adjacency, support, and kin-like intimacy without erasing the two parties.

activation_trace.role: The interval or middle between two parties supplies the relational site in which hostility is lodged.
Enmity names the initial relation and stands as the direct opposite of alliance.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the spatial form of the converted relation.
Love, support, and alliance supply the social function that replaces enmity.
A close relative who loves and is loved intensifies the result from truce to kin-like intimacy.

changed_reading.before: The command manages an enemy while preserving distance.
changed_reading.after: The better response works on the between-space itself, converting a hostile relation into near, supportive, kin-like adjacency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sudden-result construction فإذا is qualified by the simile كأنه rather than a bare identity statement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse presents an abrupt relational reappearance: the opponent comes to function as though an intimate ally. The simile preserves alterity and prevents the command from promising total control over the opponent's inner state.

activation_trace.role: The enemy relation remains the stated point of departure.
Alliance, love, and support define the new functional likeness.
Mutual familial closeness gives the simile its strongest relational image.

changed_reading.before: Doing better guarantees that an enemy internally becomes a friend.
changed_reading.after: Doing better can abruptly produce the conduct and proximity of intimate alliance, while كأنه leaves the other's inward identity outside the responder's control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same bilateral between-slot that was earlier occupied by a barrier is occupied in the focus by hostility and then reopened as proximity. The better response therefore repairs a blocked channel, not merely the opponent's mood.

activation_trace.role: The repeated bilateral interval first locates the claimed separation between speakers.
Prevention of access turns that earlier interval into an obstructed communication channel.
The focus reuses the bilateral interval as the place occupied by enmity.
Nearness without a gap supplies the repaired channel's endpoint.

structural_cues: 41:5 and 41:34 repeat a two-sided بيننا/بينك and بينك/بينه construction.
The earlier interval contains a حجاب; the focus interval contains عداوة and then yields ولي حميم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated bilateral slot, its barrier, and its later hostile-to-near reversal; I infer that the response reopens the channel itself. A live alternative is simple verbal recurrence without a deliberate barrier-repair mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Superior conduct softens an isolated hostile person.
changed_reading.after: Superior conduct reopens a previously blocked between-space, allowing communication and proximity to replace the barrier relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier سوي images equality in apportioned provision and purposeful orientation toward a destination. In the focus, its negation followed by دفع redirects action away from account-balancing and toward the better course.

activation_trace.role: Equality and equivalence give concrete measure to the earlier provision for those who ask.
Turning and intending toward a direction supplies a movement from measurement to purposeful orientation.
Negated equivalence refuses to balance good and evil as matching quantities.
Active displacement turns the refusal of equivalence into a directed response.

structural_cues: The surah moves from سواء in measured provision to استوى إلى as directed intention before لا تستوي in the focus.
The focus couples non-equivalence directly to an imperative rather than leaving it as classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three distinct سوي constructions; I read their sequence as teaching measured but nonreciprocal direction. The alternative is that the earlier cosmological uses do not constrain the interpersonal imperative.

changed_reading.before: Responding better is a generous way to settle the score.
changed_reading.after: Responding better rejects score-matching itself and deliberately orients action toward a superior, restorative result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah elsewhere names plural enemies of God under collective judgment, while the focus locates singular عداوة in a between-relation capable of becoming alliance. The focus opponent is thus not frozen into an ontological enemy type.

activation_trace.role: The plural enemy category appears as a gathered collective under judgment.
The repeated plural enemy category receives a fixed retributive destination.
The singular focus occurrence names enmity as the relation between two parties.
Alliance and support supply the mutable interpersonal relation's contrasting outcome.

structural_cues: 41:19 and 41:28 use plural enemies of God in collective judgment scenes.
41:34 uses singular عداوة inside the syntax of what lies between you and him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies different number, relational syntax, and outcomes; I infer a distinction between a judged collective category and mutable interpersonal enmity. The alternative is that the focus can address an individual within the same broader enemy class.

changed_reading.before: The verse commands friendliness toward a person whose enemy identity remains fixed.
changed_reading.after: The verse treats interpersonal enmity as a contingent between-state that may be transformed, without cancelling the surah's separate language of collective judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hostile speech tries to defeat recitation through mixed noise and overpowering force; immediately before the focus, the better speech joins invitation with reparative action. دفع بالتي هي أحسن becomes a counter-channel that defeats noise without copying its coercive method.

activation_trace.role: Mixed vocal noise supplies the hostile tactic of jamming a meaningful address.
Overpowering force states the noise-makers' intended communicative outcome.
Excellent beneficent action qualifies the immediately preceding speech as the superior alternative.
Articulated speech makes the goodness explicitly communicative rather than merely private.
Calling and inclining another through speech supplies a noncoercive direction for the address.
Removing estrangement between people binds the excellent word to practical relational repair.
Warding off harm turns excellent speech and repair into an active answer to communicative aggression.

structural_cues: 41:26 joins لا تسمعوا, deliberate noise, and the aim of overpowering.
41:33 places أحسن beside speech, calling, and صالح action immediately before 41:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a noise-for-dominance tactic and, later, best speech joined to repair; I infer that the focus imperative answers the earlier speech conflict at channel level. The alternative is that 41:34 generalizes beyond speech and is only incidentally adjacent to 41:33.

changed_reading.before: The better response is unspecified interpersonal niceness.
changed_reading.after: It is a disciplined counter-address: keep meaning audible, call rather than overpower, and embody the word in action that removes estrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response must be received and held through restraint, because provocation specifically corrupts the between-relation. Refuge interrupts that inward goad before دفع can become mirrored aggression.

activation_trace.role: Receiving and taking in an utterance frames the response-pattern as an acquired capacity.
Restraining the self from panic or reactive distress supplies the internal brake required by the command.
Incitement that corrupts the relation between parties names the pressure that would reverse repair into conflict.
Seeking shelter supplies the protective redirection used when internal provocation arrives.
Warding off harm remains outwardly active but is now constrained by inward restraint and refuge.

structural_cues: 41:35 repeats the exclusive reception formula and ties it to patience.
41:36 immediately follows with a conditional provocation and an imperative to seek refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, relationship-corrupting incitement, and refuge directly after the focus; I infer a two-stage mechanism in which inward interruption protects the outward better response. The alternative is that 41:36 addresses a separate temptation rather than the execution of 41:34.

changed_reading.before: The verse supplies an outward technique for changing an enemy.
changed_reading.after: It first requires regulation of the responder: restrain reactive imitation and take refuge from the goad that would corrupt the relation again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later earth scene moves through sudden stirring, growth, and life after an enabling input. Its فإذا pivot activates a regenerative model for the focus: the better act may supply conditions under which dormant relational capacity crosses a visible threshold.

activation_trace.role: Earth and vegetation stirring into life supply the first visible movement after the input.
Nourishment and growth supply the development of a latent capacity rather than a forced substitution.
The life of earth through rain completes the regenerative sequence.
The superior beneficial act supplies the proposed enabling input in the interpersonal domain.
Alliance and support are the relational life that becomes newly visible.

structural_cues: Both 41:34 and 41:39 use فإذا at the point where a previously described state visibly reverses.
41:39 explicitly sequences enabling input, movement, growth, and restored life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two sudden pivots and the earth's input-to-life sequence; I transfer that sequence analogically to relational change. The alternative is that shared فإذا marks only ordinary suddenness and licenses no regenerative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The better act directly manufactures friendship in the opponent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it creates life-giving conditions in which a dormant possibility of alliance may stir, grow, and suddenly become visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later rule sends صالح action toward the actor's own self and harmful action against it. Good and evil do not merely produce different effects in the opponent; they form opposite trajectories in the responder.

activation_trace.role: Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the action whose benefit returns to the actor.
Causing harm supplies the action whose adverse direction falls against the actor.
Negated equivalence now distinguishes not only social tactics but their trajectories through the responder.
The active better response wards off both external harm and the responder's reproduction of it.

structural_cues: 41:46 balances صالح action for the self against إساءة upon it.
The balanced syntax contrasts with 41:34's explicit denial that good and evil are equivalent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite reflexive directions for good and evil; I infer that 41:34 also protects the responder's moral formation. The alternative is that 41:46 states only individual recompense and does not describe the interpersonal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The command is justified chiefly by its chance of changing the enemy.
changed_reading.after: The command also prevents hostility from forming the responder into its likeness; superior action has a beneficial reflexive trajectory even when the opponent does not change.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence diagnoses failed address as distance and communal split, then moves toward truth becoming clear. The focus's conversion from hostile interval to nearness can therefore be read as restoring the conditions of intelligibility, with friendship as a relational likeness rather than a manipulable endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Distance from nearness makes the call fail as though it came from a remote place.
A group split open by disagreement supplies the social structure of communicative estrangement.
Explicit remoteness intensifies the schism into a distance across which address fails.
Emergence into clarity supplies the epistemic result when distance no longer blocks recognition.
The interpersonal interval is the focus location where distance can be reduced.
Nearness without a gap supplies restored communicability's relational form.

structural_cues: 41:44 renders blocked hearing as a call from a distant place.
41:52 names a far schism, and 41:53 follows with signs shown until truth becomes clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a distance-to-schism-to-clarity sequence; I infer that superior response reduces relational noise so recognition becomes possible. The alternative is that the final clarification concerns divine signs alone and should not be transferred to interpersonal repair.

changed_reading.before: The command aims directly at producing affection.
changed_reading.after: The command first restores nearness and intelligibility across a hostile split; ally-like affection is a possible emergent result, not a technique of control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material water branches of دفع inside an interpersonal command. It remains anchored in the focus imperative and yields a coherent pressure-and-channel mechanism, but downstream prose should mark it as a branch analogy, not as the lexical sense demanded by the syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative ادفع carries branch images of surging water and the channels into which it is driven.

activation_trace.role: A crowding surge of flood or wave supplies an image for escalating hostile pressure.
Watercourses and outlets supply the mechanism of routing pressure into a different path.
Beneficent action beyond bare equivalence names the channel through which hostile force is redirected.

changed_reading.before: The responder blocks or suppresses hostility head-on.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the responder routes hostile pressure through a better channel so that its momentum no longer feeds reciprocal injury.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع د و to ع و د mapping, while the context occurrences are the proper name عاد. It remains formally anchored in the supplied split inventory and is useful as a recurrence detector, but it must be presented only as paronomastic activation, never as the asserted lexical meaning of عداوة or عاد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ع د و is packet-mapped not only to enmity but also to the ع و د branch of return after departure.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure activates enmity as a response-cycle that repeatedly comes back.
The repeated mapped return image in a proper-name occurrence keeps recurrence audible as a form-level trigger.
The explicit proper-name branch contains the activation and prevents treating return as the contextual word's direct sense.
Displacement supplies the action that interrupts the returning hostile pattern.

changed_reading.before: Each hostile act is an isolated event requiring a better reply.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, enmity is a returning cycle, and the superior response displaces the recurrence rather than merely winning one exchange.

strongest_changes: The repeated bilateral between-slot turns the focus into repair of a blocked relational channel.
The contrast between noisy domination and immediately adjacent best speech makes the better response a noncoercive counter-address embodied in repair.
Patience, relationship-corrupting provocation, and refuge add an inward regulation stage before outward action.
The closing distance, schism, and clarification sequence shifts the proximate aim from manufacturing affection to restoring intelligibility.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly staged barriers, distances, enemy categories, and competing speech channels around the focus; the later فإذا revival scene also opened a contained regenerative reading that a local reading would likely miss.
remaining_uncertainties: فإذا can mark a striking result without guaranteeing that every opponent will change, and كأنه preserves likeness rather than identity.
The cosmological and earth-revival parallels may be rhetorical echoes rather than constraints on the interpersonal mechanism.
The hydraulic and non-dominant ع د و to ع و د activations are deliberately exploratory and should not be promoted to direct lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Force is transduced rather than mirrored.** **س و ي B001** supplies equality, here negated; **ح س ن B001/B002** gives goodness and beneficent action; **س و ء B001/B002** badness and harm; **د ف ع B001** pushing away. Because unequal moral qualities are followed by a command to repel with the better one, I infer that response need not reproduce the incoming force's quality. The ayah reads as transformation of force, not passive nonresponse.
2. **The relational interval is reconfigured into nearness.** **ب ي ن B002/B003** supplies interval and tie, **ع د و B003** enmity, **و ل ي B001/B004** nearness and loyal support, and **ح م م B011** intimate friend. The same *between* that holds hostility remains present as the relation changes. I infer that the better response acts on the bond, not only on the opponent. Enemy and ally remain distinct states, with a visible mechanism connecting them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:36 identifies **ن ز غ B001/B002**, incitement and verbal jab, as the disturbance most likely to interrupt this conversion. 41:43 later places repeated hostile speech within a longer messenger history, widening the patience horizon.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The better act is an active counterforce that rewires relation.** Lexically, `د ف ع B001` is pushing away and warding harm, `ح س ن B002` beneficent good action, `ب ي ن B003` the connection tying parties, `ع د و B003` enmity, `و ل ي B004` loyal alliance, and `ح م م B011` an intimate friend or near kin. Structurally, non-equivalence is followed by an imperative and then an abrupt relational state change within the repeated `بينك وبينه`. I assign the better act the role of asymmetric counterforce and the interpersonal interval the role of the medium it changes. The inferred arrow is that refusing reciprocal harm interrupts the feedback sustaining hostility and permits proximity to form. The ayah reads as a mechanism of conflict transformation, not passive niceness.

2. **Non-equivalence is productive asymmetry.** `س و ي B001` is equality/equivalence and is explicitly negated, while `س و ء B001` and `ح س ن B001` mark opposed qualities. The following result shows why they are not equal: one response can transform the relation rather than reproduce its input. I infer a system-level criterion from the sequence. Good and bad read differently because they generate different relational futures.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:36 clarified why patient reception is necessary: incitement specifically attacks the newly transformed relation. 41:39’s staged revival further suggested that durable change, like dormant earth stirring and rising, is a process rather than an instant mood.

Çocukların ve hayvanların iyi durumda olması, belirli bir söz kalıbına bağlı değerlendirmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar düzgünleştirme ile düzgün duruma gelmeyi birbirine bağlı verir; insan yapısındaki sağlık ve tamlık ile ev halkı ve hayvanların iyi durumu bu çekirdeğin özel görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.text: kendi içinde düzgün ve tam duruma gelme

error_profile.preserves: Tek varlığın kendi yapısındaki düzgünleşme, tamlık ve iyi duruma gelme özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Önceden eğri olan bir nesnenin düz ve doğru duruma gelmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıçtaki eğriliğin giderilmesini ve düzgünleşme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanın görünüş ve sağlık bakımından kusursuz sayılan yapısını anlatırken kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir şeyi doğrultma eylemini ve organlar ile sıcaklık arasındaki dengeyi ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da eğrilik ya da dengesizlikten uzak, düzgün bir durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tek varlığın yapısal tamlığına ve sağlığına uzanır; komşu dal ise doğrultma eylemi ile beden veya sıcaklık dengesini daha belirgin biçimde öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, üzerine gelme bildiren yapı içinde hem bir bineğin üstüne çıkıp yerleşmeyi hem de üstün gelip egemen olmayı verir; bu nedenle dal yalnız bedensel yükselişle sınırlandırılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız üzerine gelme yapısına bağlıdır; bir yöne yönelme ya da iki şeyin eşitliği bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız üzerine gelme bildiren yapıya bağlanır ve bu yapının yükselme, yerleşme ve egemen olma kapsamını korur.

facets.statement: Bir bineğin ya da başka bir şeyin üstüne çıkmak ve onun üzerinde yerleşmek temel somut kullanımdır.
Aynı yapı üstün gelip denetimi ele alma ve egemen olma anlamına genişleyebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız bir hedefe doğru yönelme bildiren yapıyı açıklar; bunu yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi sunmaz.

Yöneliş bazı açıklamalarda hedefe erişme, bazılarında hedefle ilgili işi düzenleme olarak belirginleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek bir hedefe dönme ve onu amaç edinmedir; toplu kaynak anlatımı bu yönelişin hedefe varma veya hedefle ilgili işi yürütme biçiminde yorumlanabildiğini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı insanın gençliğinin tamamlanmasını, gücünün ve kavrayışının olgunlaşmasını bu dalda toplar; belirli bir yaş yalnız olası bir sınır açıklamasıdır.

facets.statement: İnsanın gençlik dönemindeki gelişiminin tamamlanması temel anlamdır.
Bu tamamlanma güç, beden yapısı ve kavrayışın olgunlaşmasıyla açıklanır.
Kırk yaş, olgunluğun kendisi değil, kaynak anlatımında verilen olası bir yaş sınırıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımının ortak yönü insanın gençliğinin ve gücünün tamamlanmasıdır; kırk yaş açıklaması çekirdeği değiştiren zorunlu bir koşul değil, olgunluğun sınırına ilişkin bir yorumdur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı somut orta konumu, iki yana eşit ve herkesçe bilinen yeri, ayrıca hak gözeten ortak tutumu aynı dalda verir; bunlar tek bir belirsiz orta sözüne indirgenmemelidir.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün ya da yerin iki uç arasında kalan orta bölümü somut çekirdektir.
Ortalık ilişkisi, taraflara eşit davranan yansız ve hak gözetir tutuma genişler.
Belirli yer kullanımında iki yana denk, ortada ve herkesçe bilinen buluşma yeri anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar somut ortayı temel alır ve bu ilişkiyi iki taraf arasında yansız, hak gözetir konuma taşır; yer ve ortak söz kullanımları bu iki yönün belirli bağlamlardaki biçimleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سوى وسواء بمعنى غير، والبدل أو المكان المنفصل عن المخاطب في نحو عندي رجل سواك.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السواء بمعنى الوسط أو العدل، ولا سوى بمعنى نفس الشيء في النقل المختلف.
branches.source_phrase_ar: سوى مقصور إذا كان في موضع غير (ayn)؛ سواء الشيء غيره (sihah;tahdhib)؛ مررت برجل سواك أي غيرك (sihah)؛ هذا سوى ذلك أي غيره (maqayis)؛ يستعمل سوى وسواء بمعنى غير (mufradat)؛ عندي رجل سواك أي مكانك وبدلك (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyim belirli bir kişiyi doğrudan hedeflemekten çok onun yöneldiği yöne ya da hedefe yönelmeyi anlatır; övgünün birine çevrilmesi ve hedefi ıskalama örneği de yön doğrultusunu öne çıkarır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen söz yapısında yön ve hedef bildirir; genel başkalık ya da bağımsız amaçlama anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım belirli söz yapısına bağlı yönelme anlamını korur ve bunu yalın biçime ait genel bir anlam olarak sunmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz yapısı içinde bir kişinin yöneldiği hedefe ya da doğrultuya yönelmek; sözü veya övgüyü o doğrultudaki kişiye çevirmek.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin kendisini değil, onun tuttuğu yönü veya amaçladığı hedefi izlemek temel ilişkidir.
Sözün ya da övgünün belirli bir kişiye çevrilmesi, yönelme ilişkisinin söylem alanındaki kullanımıdır.
Atışın iki hedefin bulunduğu yönü tutturamaması, doğrultunun hedefle ilişkisini gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı birinin tuttuğu yönü hedef alma çekirdeğinde birleşir; övgünün o yana çevrilmesi ve atışın hedefleri ıskalaması bu yön ilişkisinin farklı bağlamlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız belirli söz yapısı içinde bir kişinin yönünü ya da hedefini izlemeyi anlatan kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yönelten kişiyi, onun tuttuğu doğrultuyu ve aynı hedefe dönme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin seçtiği doğrultunun izlenmesi veya onun hedefinin hedeflenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin tuttuğu doğrultuyu ve aynı yöne dönme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün ya da övgünün belirli bir kişiye çevrilmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Söylemin yönünü belirli kişiye çevirme ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birinin tuttuğu yöne ya da hedefe yönelmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız belirli bir söz yapısında başka bir kişinin tuttuğu yönü ya da hedefi izler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel amaçlama, bilinçli yönelme ve ok ya da mızrağı doğrudan hedefe çevirme eylemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir hedef seçme ve hareketi ya da dikkati o hedefe çevirme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel ve doğrudan amaçlamayı anlatır; odak dal ise başka birinin yönünü izleyen, belirli söz yapısına bağlı dolaylı yöneliştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşu hedefe yönelme çekirdeğini paylaşır ve odak dalın kişi üzerinden kurulan yapısal sınırını gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قصدت سوى فلان بمعنى قصدت قصده، وصرف الكلام أو المدح نحو شخص.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو سوى بمعنى غير، ولا استوى إلى السماء بالتركيب الفعلي، ولا المساواة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال قصدت سوى فلان كما يقال قصدت قصده (maqayis)؛ قصدت سوى فلان أي قصدت قصده (sihah)؛ فلأصرفن سوى حذيفة مدحتى (maqayis;sihah)؛ وقع المزار على سواهما أخطأهما (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı geniş açık araziyi temel alır, fakat bir aktarımda bozkırdaki pürüzsüz yer öne çıkar; otlak ve su için kullanılan bolluk anlatımı ise bu mekânsal genişliğin uzantısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal açık ve geniş yer ile buna bağlı bolluğu anlatır; eş, orta ya da deve sırtlığı anlamlarından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın arazi adını temel alır ve otlak ile suya ilişkin bolluk kullanımını ona bağlı bir genişleme olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Geniş, açık ve yer yer pürüzsüz bir arazi ya da bozkır yeri; buradaki mekânsal genişlikten hareketle ot veya suyun bol ve yaygın oluşu.

facets.statement: Ufku açık, geniş bir arazi parçası dalın temel yer anlamıdır.
Bir anlatım bu geniş yeri özellikle bozkırdaki pürüzsüz bir alan olarak sınırlar.
Arazinin genişliği, otlağın veya suyun çok ve yaygın oluşunu anlatmaya genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımında geniş açık arazi ortak çekirdektir; pürüzsüz bozkır yeri bunun daha dar betimlemesi, ot ve su bolluğu ise genişlik düşüncesinin nitelik alanına taşınmasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geniş, açık ve kimi bağlamlarda pürüzsüz bir bozkır yerini anlatan yalın yer adı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arazinin geniş, açık ve yer niteliği taşıyan temel anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ot ya da suyun çok ve yaygın oluşuna uzanan niteliksel kullanım bu kısa karşılıkta görünmez.

contextual_glosses.text: geniş, düz ve açık bozkır yeri
contextual_glosses.applicability: Arazinin hem genişliği hem de bozkır içindeki pürüzsüz yüzeyi öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Genişliği, açıklığı, bozkır bağlamını ve pürüzsüz yüzey niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Otlak ya da suyun geniş alana yayılan çokluğunu anlatan uzantı kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Mekânsal genişliğin ot veya su bolluğuna taşınan uzantısını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: geniş, açık ya da pürüzsüz arazi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal pürüzsüz bozkır yerini ve ot ile suyun bol oluşuna uzanan kullanımı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal boş yer, avlu, yüzey, yan ve örtüsüz alan gibi daha çeşitli açık yer türlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da üstü örtülü olmayan, açık ve geniş bir kara parçasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geniş bozkır ve pürüzsüz arazi çevresinde toplanıp bolluğa uzanır; komşu dal ise farklı türden çıplak ve açık yerleri daha geniş bir adlandırma alanında toplar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; seçilen komşu açık arazi çekirdeğini paylaşır ve bozkır, pürüzsüzlük ile bolluk sınırlarını görünür kılar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السِيّ بمعنى الفضاء الواسع من الأرض أو الموضع الأملس، وما وصف من كلأ أو ماء بالسعة والكثرة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السِيّ بمعنى المثل، ولا السَّويّة التي تلقى على البعير، ولا السواء وسط الشيء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السِيّ الفضاء من الأرض الواسع (jamhara)؛ ومن الباب السِيّ الفضاء من الأرض (maqayis)؛ السِيّ موضع بالبادية أملس (ayn)؛ نزلنا في كلاء سِيّ وأنبط ماء سِيًّا أي كثيرا واسعا (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımları aynı nesneyi kimi yerde deve için bir sırtlık, kimi yerde hörgüç çevresine sarılan ya da doldurulan örtü olarak açıklar; tanım bu yapım ve biçim çeşitliliğini korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal deve sırtında binmek için kullanılan nesneye özgüdür; eşitleme, açık arazi ya da yay parçası anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın nesne adını verir ve kaynaklardaki sırtlık, dolgulu örtü ve hörgüç çevresi biçimlerini aynı araç altında toplar.

concept_map.definition: Devenin sırtına ya da hörgücünün çevresine konup binmeye yarayan, kimi biçimi sarılı veya dolgulu örtüye, kimi biçimi sırtlığa benzeyen araç.

facets.statement: Nesne devenin sırtına yerleştirilir ve binicinin oturmasına ya da binmesine yarar.
Kaynak anlatımları nesneyi sırtlık, sarılı örtü veya bitki sapı ve lifle doldurulmuş örtü biçimlerinde betimler.
Örtü biçimi devenin hörgücünün çevresini sararak binici için oturma yeri oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak işlev devenin sırtında binmeye yarayan bir araç olmaktır; toplu anlatım aracın sırtlık, sarılı örtü veya içi doldurulmuş örtü biçimlerinde tasarlanabildiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: devenin sırtına konan dolgulu binme örtüsü
concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin sırtı ya da hörgücü çevresinde binicinin oturmasını sağlayan örtü veya sırtlık türü araç için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deve sırtındaki konumu, binme işlevini ve örtü biçimindeki yaygın yapıyı korur.
error_profile.loses: Örtüden çok katı bir sırtlık gibi açıklanan kaynak biçimi bu kısa karşılıkta geri planda kalır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin örtü yapısından çok deve üzerinde binmeye yarayan sırtlık oluşu öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deve sırtındaki konumu ve biniciyi taşıyan araç olma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sarılı veya içi bitki sapı ve lifle doldurulmuş örtü biçimi belirtilmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aracın hörgüç çevresine sarılan ve biniciye oturma yeri sağlayan örtü biçimi anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hörgüç çevresindeki yerleşimi, örtü yapısını ve binme işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: devenin sırtına ya da hörgücü çevresine konan binme örtüsü

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal deveye özgü sırtlık ya da dolgulu örtüyü ve hörgüç çevresindeki yerleşimini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kadın için hazırlanan taşıma düzeneğini ve sedye benzeri daha büyük bir binme aracını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da deve sırtında veya hörgüç çevresinde biniciyi taşıyan örtülü bir düzenek anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal deve sırtlığı ve dolgulu örtü biçiminde sınırlıdır; komşu dal buna ek olarak kapalı ya da sedye benzeri taşıma düzeneklerini de kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşu nesne ve işlev bakımından en yakın eşleşmedir, ancak daha büyük taşıma düzeneği kapsamıyla ayrılır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السَّويّة وهي كساء أو قتب أو برذعة تجعل على ظهر البعير أو حول سنامه للركوب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو التسوية بمعنى التعديل، ولا السِيّ الفضاء، ولا سِيَة القوس أو الأسد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السَّويّة قتب أعجمي للبعير والجميع السوايا (ayn;tahdhib)؛ السَّويّة كساء يلف ويجعل شبيها بالحوية يلقى على سنام البعير (jamhara)؛ السَّويّة كساء محشو بثمام ونحوه كالبرذعة (sihah)؛ كساء محشو بثمام أو ليف يجعل على ظهر البعير (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bir şeyi, yazıdaki bir bölümü ya da geçilen bir yeri atlama, bırakma ve göz ardı etme işlemini açıkça aynı çekirdekte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir öğeyi işlem dışında bırakmayı anlatır; düzeltme, eşitleme ya da orta konum bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bırakma ve atlama eylemini verir; örneklerdeki yazı parçasını bütün dal için zorunlu nesne saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi izlenen sıra, işlem ya da anlatım içinde atlayarak dışarıda bırakma ve ona gereken ilgiyi göstermeme.

facets.statement: Bir öğeyi izlenen işlem ya da sıra içine almadan atlamak temel eylemdir.
Atlanan öğeyi bırakmak ve ona gereken ilgiyi göstermemek eylemin sonuç yönüdür.
Bir yazı bölümünü veya geçilen bir yeri atlamak, çekirdeğin belirli nesneler üzerindeki örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir öğeyi sıradan düşürme, üzerinden geçme ve ilgisiz bırakma çekirdeğinde birleşir; yazı bölümü ile geçilen yer bu işlemin ayrı örnekleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir öğenin sıra, işlem veya anlatım içine alınmayarak bırakılması ve göz ardı edilmesi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Atlama işlemini, öğenin dışarıda kalmasını ve ona ilgi gösterilmemesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yazı ya da anlatımdaki parçanın okunmadan veya aktarılmadan geçilmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir bölümün sıra içinde işlenmeden geçilmesi anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bilinçli ya da sonuç bakımından işlem dışında bırakıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öğeyi bırakma ve ona gereken ilgiyi göstermeme sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: atlamak, dışarıda bırakmak ve göz ardı etmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir öğeyi sıra, işlem veya anlatım içinde atlayıp dışarıda bırakmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yetersiz kalma, savsaklama, unutma, geride bırakma ve bütünüyle yitirme sonuçlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeye gereken işlemi veya ilgiyi göstermeyerek onu bırakma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal seçili bir öğeyi atlama ve göz ardı etme işlemidir; komşu dal ise yetersizlikten doğan savsaklama, unutma ve yitirme sonuçlarına daha geniş biçimde uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; seçilen komşu bırakma alanını paylaşır ve odak dalın sıradan bir öğeyi atlama özelliğini en açık biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أسوى الشيء أو الحرف إذا أسقطه أو تركه وأغفله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو التسوية ولا الاستواء ولا السواء بمعنى العدل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أسوى فلان حرفا من كتاب الله أي أسقط وأغفل (ayn)؛ أسويت الشيء أي تركته وأغفلته (sihah)؛ أسوى برزخا ثم رجع إليه (tahdhib)؛ أسوى يعني أسقط وأغفل (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bu gece adını ayın on üçüncü gecesi olarak belirler ve adlandırmayı ayın o sıradaki dengeli görünümüne bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız ayın on üçüncü gecesinin adıdır; yer ortası, yansızlık ya da genel ay ışığı anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım gece adını kendi başına verir ve başka dallardaki orta, eşitlik veya düzgünlük anlamlarını ona taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Ayın görünümünün dengelendiği kabul edilen, ayın on üçüncü gecesine verilen ad.

facets.statement: Adlandırılan zaman ayın on üçüncü gecesidir.
Gece adı, ayın o sırada dengeli bir görünüme erişmesi açıklamasıyla ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayın on üçüncü gecesini aynı adla belirler; bunlardan biri adın ayın o gecedeki dengeli görünümüne dayandığını ayrıca açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ayın dengeli göründüğü kabul edilen belirli geceyi takvim içindeki sırasıyla adlandırmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayı, geceyi ve ay içindeki on üçüncü sıra koşulunu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gece adının hem takvimdeki sırası hem de ayın görünümüyle bağı açıklanmak istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: On üçüncü geceyi ve adlandırmanın ayın dengeli görünümüyle kurulan bağını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ayın dengeli göründüğü on üçüncü gece

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ay içindeki belirli bir sıraya, on üçüncü geceye verilen addır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gökteki ayı, onun ışığını ve ay ışığıyla aydınlanan geceleri genel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ayın gece göğündeki görünümü ve aydınlığı çevresindeki aynı zaman alanına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız takvimde belirli bir geceyi adlandırır; komşu dal ise ayın kendisini, ışığını ve aydınlattığı geceleri tarih sırasından bağımsız biçimde kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşu aynı gök ve gece alanını paylaşır, ancak belirli gece adıyla genel ay ve ışık anlamını açıkça ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ليلة السواء، وهي ليلة ثلاث عشرة عند استواء القمر في النقلين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السواء بمعنى العدل أو الوسط في المكان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ليلة السواء ليلة ثلاث عشرة (sihah)؛ السواء ممدود ليلة ثلاث عشرة وفيها يستوي القمر (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı sabit söz içinde bir kişinin başına denk sayılan mal miktarını verir, fakat aynı kalıp bolluk veya iyi yaşam durumu için de kullanılır; tanım iki görünümü ayırmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız baş ölçüsü çevresinde kurulan söz kalıbına bağlıdır; genel eşitlik, para adı ya da herhangi bir mal miktarı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız baş ölçüsünü kullanan kalıba bağlanır ve buradaki mal ile bolluk anlamını yalın biçime genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz kalıbında bir kişinin başına denk ya da onu karşılar sayılan mal miktarı; aynı kalıpta kişinin içinde bulunduğu bolluk ve iyi yaşam durumu.

facets.statement: Mal miktarı kişinin başına denk sayılan bir ölçüyle anlatılır.
Baş ölçüsüne denk mal düşüncesi, kişinin bolluk ve iyi yaşam içinde bulunmasını anlatmaya genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı başa denk sayılan mal ölçüsü ile bu ölçünün bolluk ve iyi yaşam durumu bildiren kullanımını aynı söz kalıbında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız baş ölçüsü çevresinde kurulan kalıp içinde mal miktarını veya kişinin bolluk içindeki durumunu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Başla kurulan denkliği, mal miktarını ve bolluk durumuna uzanan kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıbın bir kişinin başına denk sayılan mal miktarını bildirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin başını ölçü alan denkliği ve bunun mal miktarı oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aynı söz kalıbının mal ölçüsünden çok kişinin iyi ve bol durumunu anlattığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıbın kişiye bağlanan bolluk ve iyi yaşam durumunu korur.
